text:
emma: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. Dropping RCA link + condensed action list from the leadership segment.

alex: Link? where can I find the RCA and the short action list?

emma: RCA here: https://docs.internal.redwood.com/rca/INC-2024-0315 — see summary tab for timeline and root cause.

devon: Quick Q — what's the rollout pause timeline mentioned in the talk?

ravi: Per all-hands, pause on model rollouts for the affected shards until 2024-03-22 EOD or until mitigation tests pass (whichever is earlier). Owner: devon. :calendar:

maria: I created a tiny actions doc with owners + due dates: https://docs.internal.redwood.com/playbooks/2024-03-15-incident-actions (eng-leads have edit).

devon: Ack — I'll do infra smoke tests tomorrow 08:30 PT. For reference, the quick grep I used to spot the spike in errors was: 
```
rg 'ERROR|timeout' /var/log/redwood/runtime/*.log | tail -n 200
```

ops-bot: [automation] Incident INC-2024-0315 status changed to 'Monitoring' — 3 actions remain open: runbook update, rollback criteria, postmortem publish.

sam: Can leadership clarify the SLO change request timeframe? I'm triaging customer comms and need a deadline. @emma @alex

emma: We will run a follow-up meeting with eng leads tomorrow 10:30 PT. Agenda: SLO guidance, rollback criteria, comms cadence. Invite incoming.

alex: Also need to confirm default fallback policy for Dedicated — are we going with model-fallback X or Y for latency-sensitive routes? This affects deployment gating.

ravi: Decision from infra is fallback X for latency-sensitive routes. We'll document the exception path for heavier accuracy-sensitive traffic. Runbook section updated by devon.

devon: Runbook update pushed to the repo, will ping ops and this thread when PR merges.

maria: Checklist now includes owners + due dates; added a column for handoff notes. Ping me if you need edit perms. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks all — very helpful. Posting this in the all-hands follow thread as a concise summary. Will close here once runbook PR is merged.
